name: Volumes exceed documented production or capacity
description: Exports or output reported exceed documented production, concession or capacity limits.
fp: Stockpiles, undocumented but legitimate sources or reporting lags.

links.name: Timber exports exceeding documented concession capacity
links.ctx: Export volumes from a client are higher than its licensed harvest area could plausibly yield.
links.fp: Stocks and purchases from other licensed sources may explain.

links.name: Exports exceeding official production of origin country
links.ctx: Quantities exported by a country or trader exceed credible domestic production.
links.fp: Trade statistics can have timing differences.
